- [RARC.5.7.5] **Publish dispatcher.** Judges the action's values as an
  `emit`'s are judged ([LTIE.4.8]) and asserts nothing into working memory
  ([LTIE.4.3]). It delivers an `ACTION_PUBLISH` stream event carrying a view of
  the published fact, valid while the callback runs, and its `FactExternal`
  encoding ([NCBK.2.5], [NCBK.10.1]). The integrator's stream callback
  observes the event and decides whether, and how, to forward it upward to
  another tier.
